title: dx-sdk-todos-scratchpad
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for SDK docs cleanup + sample app fixes

Top priority:
- Finish updated quickstart tutorial (js + python): missing auth snippet for Hosted API -> add example with API key env var and Redwood client init
- Sample app: simple chatwidget (React) demo broken on streaming; investigate Server-Sent Events fallback. Related PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482
- Add note about rate-limit headers and retry guidance to rate-limits section of docs (edge-case: 429 vs 503)

Medium:
- Replace outdated code snippets using 'redwood.createClient' FYI: v0.9 -> v1.0 API rename; run search-and-replace across docs
- Create minimal embedding example with batch use (python) and show chunking strategy
- Add small diagram for model selection heuristics (latency vs cost) to hosted-api doc

Low:
- Write test harness for sample apps to run in CI on PRs (smoke tests)
- Draft tutorial for Private deployment auth (KMS/HSM stub) - needs input from security

Open questions / blockers:
- Streaming example: is SSE supported on Dedicated? Asking infra (Devon).
- Where to surface quantization recommendations for SDK users vs. console (product decision)

Notes to self:
- Ping Mikaela about canonical code style for snippets (prefer TypeScript for web examples)
- Add links to SDK changelog for breaking changes section
- Plan a short internal walkthrough once quickstart is updated (15-20m demo)

Related tickets and PRs:
- SDK-117 (Linear): update quickstart snippets
- PR #482: streaming fallback for react-chatwidget (needs review from SRE)

TODO today:
- push quickstart draft -> draft PR
- reopen convo with Devon re: SSE on Dedicated
- update docs search result entries for 'createClient' rename

End.
